introHtml: Bag included bag clips combine a functional chip clip with a matching storage bag, making them ideal for corporate gift sets, snack giveaways, or safety kits. The attached bag lets recipients keep clips organized or repurpose them for lunches and travel. Choose from standard or custom-printed bags to match your brand colors, and decorate the clip with your logo via pad printing or debossing for a cohesive look that stands out on any desk or pantry shelf.
